response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE e.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND e.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: Order references and user stamps identify one matching order and user, respectively, as described in the database documentation.
